_note: The hero graphic brief's starting scene and items per niche (14 Nov 2026), keyed by the niche library file stem. `scene` fills [MAIN SCENE DESCRIPTION] after the word Show; `include` fills the items to include. Both are only a start: a person can change them on the Images tab for one client. No people in any of them. A new niche is a line here, not code.

blinds-curtains.scene: the front of a smart modern home with large windows fitted with neat blinds and shutters, and a fitter's van parked on the drive
blinds-curtains.include: a clean unmarked fitter's van, windows with roller blinds, venetian blinds and plantation shutters, a folding ladder, a cordless drill and a neat tool case

builder.scene: a tidy house extension part way through the build beside a finished brick home, with a builder's van and neatly stacked materials on the drive
builder.include: a clean unmarked builder's van, scaffolding on the extension, pallets of bricks and blocks, a cement mixer, a wheelbarrow, timber roof trusses and a spirit level

cleaning.scene: a spotless, bright modern home seen from the front path, with a cleaning company's van at the kerb and cleaning equipment set out neatly by the open front door
cleaning.include: a clean unmarked small van, a vacuum cleaner, a mop and bucket, a caddy of spray bottles and cloths, and gleaming windows and floors

dog-grooming.scene: a smart dog grooming salon front on a quiet street with a mobile grooming van parked outside and a freshly groomed dog sitting by the door
dog-grooming.include: a clean unmarked grooming van, a grooming table, a dog bath, clippers, brushes and scissors, folded towels and one or two well groomed dogs

dog-training.scene: an open, well kept training field at the edge of a town with agility equipment laid out and a calm dog sitting at attention beside a parked estate car
dog-training.include: agility jumps, a tunnel and weave poles, training cones, a long lead and a treat pouch laid on a bench, and one or two attentive dogs

drainage.scene: a residential street with a drainage van parked beside an open inspection chamber, safety barriers round it and jetting equipment laid out neatly
drainage.include: a clean unmarked drainage van with a jetting hose reel, an open manhole with its cover set beside it, drain rods, a CCTV survey camera reel, safety barriers and cones

driveways.scene: a newly laid block paved driveway sweeping up to a smart detached home, with a section still being laid and a contractor's truck at the kerb
driveways.include: a clean unmarked tipper truck, pallets of block paving and kerb stones, a plate compactor, a wheelbarrow, string lines and a neat pile of sharp sand

electrician.scene: a modern home at the end of a street with its lights glowing warmly, an electrician's van on the drive and an electric car charging at a wall charger
electrician.include: a clean unmarked electrician's van, a wall mounted EV charger, a consumer unit, cable drums, a tool case with testers and screwdrivers, and outdoor lights on the house

fencing.scene: a long run of new timber fencing along a neat garden boundary, the last panels still to go in, with a fencing contractor's truck parked alongside
fencing.include: a clean unmarked pickup truck, stacked fence panels and posts, gravel boards, a post hole digger, a spirit level, bags of post mix and a new garden gate

flooring.scene: a bright open room seen through wide patio doors with a new wood floor half laid, and a flooring fitter's van on the drive outside
flooring.include: a clean unmarked fitter's van, packs of wood and laminate boards, rolls of carpet and underlay, a knee kicker, a tape measure and a mitre saw

garage-doors.scene: a smart detached home with a new sectional garage door, part open, and an installer's van parked on the drive in front of it
garage-doors.include: a clean unmarked installer's van, a sectional garage door and a roller garage door, door tracks and a motor unit, a remote control fob, a step ladder and a tool case

guttering.scene: a row of well kept houses with new gutters and downpipes along the roofline, a ladder set against one and a guttering van at the kerb
guttering.include: a clean unmarked van with a roof rack, an extension ladder with a stand off, lengths of gutter and downpipe, fascia boards, a gutter vacuum pole and a bucket

hvac.scene: a modern home and a small commercial unit side by side with air conditioning units and a heat pump on their walls, and an engineer's van parked outside
hvac.include: a clean unmarked engineer's van, wall mounted outdoor condenser units, an air source heat pump, copper pipework and trunking, a set of manifold gauges and a tool case

kitchen-bathroom.scene: a newly fitted modern kitchen seen through wide bifold doors at the back of a home, with a fitter's van and flat packed units on the drive
kitchen-bathroom.include: a clean unmarked fitter's van, kitchen units and a stone worktop, a freestanding bath and a basin, boxes of tiles, a mitre saw and a tool case

landscaper.scene: a freshly landscaped garden behind a smart home, with a new patio, a neat lawn and planted borders, and a landscaper's truck parked at the side gate
landscaper.include: a clean unmarked tipper truck, a patio of porcelain paving, raised sleeper beds, rolls of turf, a wheelbarrow, a spade and rake, and young trees and shrubs

locksmith.scene: the front door of a smart terraced home on a quiet street with a new lock being fitted, a locksmith's van at the kerb and a tool case open on the step
locksmith.include: a clean unmarked locksmith's van, a front door with a new cylinder lock and handle, a set of keys, a lock pick set, a cordless drill and a tool case

loft-conversions.scene: a family home with a new dormer loft conversion taking shape in its roof, scaffolding round it and a builder's van on the drive
loft-conversions.include: a clean unmarked builder's van, scaffolding up to the roof, a dormer with new roof windows, timber joists, insulation boards, a roll of roofing felt and a skip

painters-decorators.scene: the front of a period home being freshly painted, one half finished and bright, with a decorator's van at the kerb and dust sheets laid neatly on the path
painters-decorators.include: a clean unmarked decorator's van, a ladder and a small scaffold tower, paint tins, rollers and brushes in a tray, dust sheets and rolls of wallpaper

pest-control.scene: a neat suburban home and garden with a pest control van parked on the drive and equipment set out tidily beside the back door
pest-control.include: a clean unmarked pest control van, bait stations along a wall, a sprayer with a lance, a torch, sealed tubs, an inspection ladder up to the loft hatch or eaves

pet-care.scene: a leafy park path at the edge of town with a pet care van parked by the gate and two happy dogs waiting beside it
pet-care.include: a clean unmarked small van with pet crates in the back, dog leads and harnesses, water bowls, a ball and toys, and two or three well looked after dogs

plumbing-heating.scene: a warm, well lit home on a cold evening with a new boiler flue on its wall, a plumber's van on the drive and tools set out neatly by the door
plumbing-heating.include: a clean unmarked plumber's van, a wall hung boiler, radiators, copper pipe and fittings, a pipe wrench, a tool bag and a hot water cylinder

pressure-washing.scene: a driveway and patio in front of a smart home, half of it washed clean and bright beside the darker unwashed half, with a jet washing van at the kerb
pressure-washing.include: a clean unmarked van with a water tank, a pressure washer with a hose reel and lance, a flat surface cleaner, and a clear line between the clean and dirty paving

removals.scene: a removals lorry parked outside a smart home with its tail lift down and boxes and wrapped furniture stacked neatly on the drive
removals.include: a clean unmarked removals lorry with a tail lift, stacked cardboard boxes, furniture in blankets, a sack truck, a wardrobe box and rolls of tape

roofer.scene: a row of homes with one roof part way through being re-tiled, scaffolding along its front and a roofer's van at the kerb
roofer.include: a clean unmarked roofer's van, scaffolding and a roof ladder, stacks of slates and tiles, battens and roofing felt, lead flashing and a chimney stack

scaffolding.scene: a tall, neatly built scaffold round a town building, with a scaffolding lorry parked below it loaded with tubes and boards
scaffolding.include: a clean unmarked flatbed scaffolding lorry, scaffold tubes, boards and fittings stacked in order, ladders tied in place, base plates and safety netting

tiling.scene: a bright modern bathroom seen through an open doorway with its wall tiles half laid, and a tiler's van on the drive outside
tiling.include: a clean unmarked tiler's van, boxes of porcelain tiles, a tile cutter, a notched trowel, a bucket of adhesive, tile spacers and a spirit level

tree-surgeon.scene: a large mature tree in a town garden, freshly pruned, with a tree surgeon's truck and wood chipper parked on the road beside it
tree-surgeon.include: a clean unmarked tipper truck towing a wood chipper, a chainsaw and a pole saw, climbing ropes and a harness hung on a branch, neat log piles and cones on the road

window-cleaning.scene: a row of homes and a glass shop front with sparkling clean windows, and a window cleaner's van at the kerb with a water fed pole set against it
window-cleaning.include: a clean unmarked van with a water tank, a water fed pole and brush, a hose reel, a squeegee and bucket, a ladder and bright reflective glass
